{{Conjecture|legends}}
The [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Qieg/Legends|Qieg]] practiced a '''religion''' on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]] that preached predestination and acceptance of the status quo. Shrines were maintained by [[Monk/Legends|monks]] in the planet's [[Lowlands (Lan Barell)|Lowlands]] region, and a rite of adulthood for Qieg involved trekking across the lowlands alone to visit the shrines.
